kimai_token: <your Kimai API token — Kimai → User → API access>
anthropic_api_key: <optional — enables AI-powered project classification via ai_matcher.py>
google_oauth_client_id: <optional — Google Cloud 'Desktop app' OAuth client id>
telegram_bot_token: <optional — enables Telegram reminders and watchdog alerts>
rescuetime_api_key: <optional — enables Android tracking, from https://www.rescuetime.com/rtx/settings/api/key_management (Data API key, leave 'Allow queries from' blank)>
rescuetime_timezone: <the timezone set in your RescueTime account, e.g. Europe/Lisbon. Required when android_sync_enabled is true. Not the same setting as kimai_timezone>
